info.title: Family Research Notes - John Robert and Myrtle Currie
info.text:
CONFIRMED BY PUBLIC RECORDS

John Robert Currie
- Born 20 December 1900 in Richmond County, North Carolina.
- Died 29 September 1984 in Fayetteville, Cumberland County, North Carolina.
- Buried at Green Lake United Methodist Church Cemetery in Rockingham, Richmond County, North Carolina.
- Parents: James Wiley Currie and Ella Porter Currie.

Myrtle Bailey Currie
- Born 1 September 1917 in Parkton, Robeson County, North Carolina.
- Died 11 October 2002 in Florida.
- Buried at Wildwood Cemetery in Bartow, Polk County, Florida.
- Parents: William Samuel Bailey and Nettie Brigman Bailey.

1950 CENSUS HOUSEHOLD

At 322 (street not shown in the indexed record), Kannapolis, Cabarrus County, North Carolina:
- J. R. Currie, age 49, head.
- Myrtle B. Currie, age 33, wife.
- Margie Currie, age 14, daughter.
- Bobby Currie, age 12, son.
- Arthur Currie, age 7, son.
- Cecil Currie, age 5, son.

The census citation is page 22, Enumeration District 13-23, roll 6265.
John was working 40 hours a week in a cotton cloth mill. The indexed occupation text reads "Sweater Sheet Dept."

LATER CHILD CONFIRMATION

Bobby Currie's 2014 obituary names his surviving siblings as Debbie Locklear, Arthur Currie, and Margie Barnes. This supports Debbie's married surname and Margie's married surname. Cecil is not named among the surviving siblings because he died in 2000.

CAUTION

- The 1950 census supports approximate birth years for Margie (about 1935-1936) and Arthur (about 1942-1943), but exact dates have not yet been confirmed.
- Bobby's obituary gives his exact birth date as 2 February 1938, which agrees with his age 12 in the 1950 census.
- Cecil's exact 1945 birth date still needs a stronger public record.
- Debbie was likely born after the 1950 census, but an exact date has not yet been confirmed.
- The Ancestry tree currently shows Bobby as born in 1946. That is incorrect; his obituary and the 1950 census support 1938.

info.title: Family Research Notes - Bobby Jean Currie and Shirley Ann Luna
info.text:
CONFIRMED BY PUBLIC OBITUARIES

Bobby Jean Currie
- Born 2 February 1938 in Kannapolis, North Carolina.
- Died 11 June 2014 in Bartow, Florida.
- Parents: John Robert Currie and Myrtle B. Bailey Currie.
- United States Air Force veteran.
- Worked as an automobile painter for local dealerships and later operated his own automobile paint shop.
- His obituary says he and Shirley had been married for 50 years, placing their marriage around 1963 or 1964. An exact marriage date has not been confirmed.

Shirley Ann Luna Currie
- Born 8 October 1946 in Bartow, Florida.
- Died 11 October 2016 in Houston, Texas.
- Parents: Robert Luna and Lois Boutwell Luna.
- Worked for many years as a switchboard operator for Florida Global Citrus.
- Buried at Wildwood Cemetery in Bartow, Florida.

CHILDREN CONFIRMED BY BOTH OBITUARIES

- Scotty Currie, who died before both parents.
- Lonnie Jean Currie.
- Bobby J. Currie. His first wife was Dawn and his later wife is Nanette.
- Christopher Leon Currie. His first wife was Elizabeth Thompson and his later wife is Terri Ann.
- Jaime Lee Currie.
- Robert Shawn Currie, known as Shawn. His former wife is Shantell.

The 2014 obituary reports 14 grandchildren and 9 great-grandchildren. The 2016 obituary reports 13 grandchildren and 12 great-grandchildren.

CAUTION

- The obituaries do not name the grandchildren or identify which son is each grandchild's father. No grandchildren have been assigned to individual sons without stronger evidence.
- Family information supplied by Bobby and Shirley's granddaughter confirms that Bobby J. and Dawn had 2 children; Bobby J. and Nanette have 3 children; and Robert Shawn and Shantell had 5 children.
- Christopher and Terri Ann have no children together. Christopher's children belong under his first marriage to Elizabeth Thompson.
- Private family information says Scotty died young from AIDS and never had children. His exact dates remain unknown.
- Private family information says Lonnie has severe autism and has no children.
- Exact birth dates for the sons have not been added from people-search or data-broker pages.
- Scotty's exact birth and death dates have not yet been confirmed.
- Bobby's funeral-home page does not contain a genuine portrait. Its image is a generic memorial dove, so that image was not retained.
- Shirley's saved obituary photograph was visually checked and is a genuine portrait.

PUBLIC RECORD SEARCH REVIEWED 28 JULY 2026

Adult descendants and relatives checked:
- Scotty Currie.
- Lonnie Jean Currie.
- Bobby J. Currie, Dawn, Nanette, Chastin Currie, Amanda Currie, Gabrielle Currie, Benjamin Currie, and Jacob Currie.
- Christopher Leon Currie, Elizabeth Thompson, Terri Ann, Ashley Danielle Currie, Christina Michelle Currie, Christopher Aaron Currie, Andreya Currie, George Mitchell, Staipe England, James Jordan, and Mark Steven Van.
- Jaime Lee Currie.
- Robert Shawn Currie and Shantell.
- Arthur Currie, Cecil Leon Currie, and Debbie Currie Locklear.

Result:
- No additional obituary, marriage-index entry, cemetery memorial, funeral-home notice, or historical record could be matched to these people with enough certainty to add as evidence.
- Several search results were commercial people-finder or data-broker pages. They were deliberately excluded because they exposed private contact or address information and did not provide reliable genealogical evidence.
- Other results belonged to different people with similar names and were also excluded.
- The existing Bobby and Shirley obituaries remain the strongest public evidence for their children and family relationships.
- Cecil Leon Currie's existing census, telephone-directory, and Social Security death-record leads remain the strongest records currently saved for him.

Research boundary:
- No searches were made for private medical information.
- Minor descendants were not researched beyond information supplied directly by family.
- A possible alternate surname shown for Chastin on a people-finder page was not accepted or saved because no reliable marriage record or published family notice confirmed it.

info.title: Family Research Notes - Margie Currie and Little Jimmie Barnes
info.text:
CONFIRMED BY PUBLIC RECORDS

Margie Currie Barnes
- Daughter of John Robert Currie and Myrtle B. Bailey Currie.
- Listed as "Marjie Currie," age 14, in the 1950 census household in Kannapolis, North Carolina.
- Her age supports a birth year of about 1935 or 1936. An exact birth date has not been confirmed.
- Bobby Currie's 2014 obituary identifies her as his sister Margie Barnes.
- Dr. Little Jimmie Barnes Sr.'s 2022 obituary identifies Margie Currie Barnes as his wife of 72 years.

Dr. Little Jimmie "L.J." Barnes Sr.
- Born 7 October 1929 in Bushnell, Florida.
- Died 27 February 2022 in Gastonia, North Carolina.
- Parents: Nathaniel Otto Barnes and Mamie Lucille Pollard Barnes.
- United States Navy veteran.
- Retired minister who served congregations in North Carolina and Florida.
- Margie and L.J. also directed and managed Camp Courtney in Hendersonville, North Carolina.
- His inurnment was private.

CHILDREN NAMED IN L.J.'S OBITUARY

- Little Jimmie Barnes Jr., spouse listed as Cyn-dee.
- Joy Barnes Fox, spouse listed as Jack Fox.
- Kathie Barnes Branton, spouse listed as Vic Branton.
- Rita Barnes Geary, spouse listed as Rick Geary.

CAUTION

- The obituary says Margie and L.J. were married for 72 years, placing their marriage around 1949 or 1950. An exact marriage date or license has not yet been located.
- Margie was still recorded under the surname Currie in the April 1950 census, so their marriage was probably after that census date if both records are exact.
- Ancestry returns a Florida county marriage-record lead for "Margie Lee Currie" in Polk County. The date and spouse are hidden without a subscription, so it has been saved only as a lead and is not treated as proof. Ancestry showed duplicate index entries for this apparent event; only one link was retained to avoid clutter.
- Margie was alive when L.J.'s obituary was published in 2022. Her current status and exact birth date have not been independently confirmed.
- No grandchildren have been assigned to individual children because the obituary lists the grandchildren together rather than clearly identifying each parent.
